scenario: [LNLS.3.3] — a composite key is anchored by one equality per `key` slot, and a further cross-pattern comparison ON TOP of the anchor is allowed ("Additional constraints ... are allowed on top of this anchor"). Both schemas key on (site, bay); the second pattern equates both slots, written with the earlier binding on the left for one and on the right for the other, and adds `x.amount > d.level`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.slot_equality` normalises either operand order, and `full_key_anchor` ignores the non-key comparison. Reading the extra comparison as a partial anchor would raise DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_A here.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Device scope logical:
    site: String key
    bay: Int key
    level: Int mutable

schema Reading scope logical:
    site: String key
    bay: Int key
    amount: Int mutable

rule joined:
    Device d
    Reading x where x.site == d.site and d.bay == x.bay and x.amount > d.level
->
    log info "x"
